title: Privacy Policy
metaDescription: What data is collected on the AI Solution House website, how it is used and what rights you have.
intro: This policy explains how privacy is handled on this website, which is operated by AI Solution House (ASH).

In short: this is an informational website. There is no member login, payment or user account. Personal data is collected from you only when you submit the contact form or book a meeting; if you consent, visit statistics are also collected with Google Analytics.

sections.heading: What data we collect
paragraphs: The site has two forms: the contact form and the newsletter sign-up field.

When you submit the contact form, your full name, email address, optional phone number and message are sent by email to our corporate address (hello@aisolutionhouse.com). This information is not stored in a separate database on the site's servers; the message is kept in our corporate email account.

When you book a meeting through the site's booking screen (on the home page, the contact page or the product pages), your full name, email address and any note you add are sent to our corporate calendar through Google Calendar.

If you give your consent in the cookie bar, Google Analytics collects usage data such as the pages you visit, visit duration, where you came from, device, browser and approximate location, using cookies. If you don't consent, this data is not collected.
The newsletter sign-up field is not yet connected to a service; the email address you enter there is not sent to us.
The infrastructure hosting the site may create technical logs such as your IP address and browser information so that the connection can be established.

sections.heading: What we use data for
bullets: Responding to the request you send through the contact form and communicating with you
Keeping the site running and secure
Preventing misuse and automated attack attempts
If you consent, understanding and improving how the site is used through aggregate statistics

sections.heading: What we don't do
bullets: We don't sell, rent or transfer your personal data for marketing purposes
We don't use advertising networks or tracking for profiling on the site
We don't run analytics without your consent, and Google Analytics' advertising and personalization features are turned off

sections.heading: What is stored in your browser
paragraphs: If the contact form cannot be sent, what you wrote is kept as a draft in your browser's local storage so that it isn't lost; the draft is deleted once the message is sent successfully. This data does not leave your device and cannot be read by us.
You can delete it at any time by clearing your browser's site data. See our cookie policy for details.

sections.heading: Third parties
paragraphs: Service providers are used to host the site. These providers may access the technical logs needed to deliver the service.

Contact form messages are delivered through our email delivery provider Resend (Resend, Inc., USA) and stored on our corporate email service, Google Workspace. These providers' servers may be located abroad.

The meeting booking screen is provided by Google Calendar (Google Workspace); it loads as you approach the meeting section of the home page, and on the contact and product pages when you click the button. Google's privacy policy applies on that screen.

Google Analytics, used only with your consent, is provided by Google; the usage data collected may be processed on Google's servers abroad. You can withdraw your consent at any time via the "Cookie preferences" link at the bottom of the page.
When you click external links on the site, that site's own privacy practices apply; they are outside the scope of this policy.

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: The site is served over HTTPS. Access permissions are kept limited, and components are run on up-to-date versions.
We know that no system can provide absolute security; that is why we consider the data we don't collect to be the safest data.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: Your rights regarding your personal data and how to apply are explained in detail in our KVKK privacy notice.
For questions, you can reach us through our contact page.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: This policy is updated when the way the site works changes. The update date at the top of the page shows from which date the text applies.
